description: Controlled vocabulary defining whether a reported quantity corresponds to raw experimentally measured data or to quantities obtained through post-processing or interpretation.

terms.definition: Quantity obtained through post-processing, analytical calculations, inverse analysis, homogenization, curve fitting, numerical interpretation, statistical processing, or other forms of data reduction applied to experimentally measured data.
Quantity corresponding directly to experimentally measured or recorded data without substantial post-processing or interpretation.
Reporting type not specified or not identifiable from the available documentation.
